_comment: Paraphrased positive probes for the syllabus gate (T1, PARAPHRASED condition). The same forty topics as in_syllabus.json, each rephrased as a Grade 6-9 learner would plausibly type it. `toc_wording` records the verbatim contents-page heading so the pairing with the VERBATIM condition is explicit.
_methodology: All forty paraphrases were authored blind to gate behaviour: none was retrieved, scored or verified while it was being written, and no phrasing was adjusted afterwards on the basis of whether it passed. --verify was run once, after the whole set was complete. The register is varied deliberately - some are questions, some bare noun phrases, some use everyday synonyms the textbooks do not use - because a learner does not type contents-page headings.
_purpose: The VERBATIM set measures the gate's ceiling: its queries are drawn from the same document the index was built from, so the wording matches the corpus by construction. This set measures the gate under realistic phrasing. The gap between the two is the robustness finding; the paraphrased figure is the operationally meaningful one.
